project.title: Vara v1 — product and module contracts
project.goal: Fast everyday dictation with local defaults, deliberate optional text AI, safe insertion and app-grouped history.
project.scope: Only the first-release scope in PRODUCT-SPEC.md. Rust domain core, three desktop targets, Mac-first development. Proposed design and structural contracts are not implementation or release evidence.
assumptions: Accepted product requirements are recorded in DECISIONS.md; this model is the requested implementation specification.
Old ideal exploration is archived under reports/history/ideal-before-v1; excluded features are not current release obligations.
No application behavior or native/provider compatibility has been verified by this specification.
